lead.description: a function for which questions about its values correspond to events, so that expectation is defined

self_checks.title: Payoff expectation
self_checks.prompt: Outcome 1 has probability 1/3 and payoff 2; the group {2, 3} has probability 2/3 and payoff 7. What is the expectation?

self_checks.title: A higher payoff on outcome 1
self_checks.prompt: Outcome 1 now pays 5, and the group {2, 3} still pays 7 with probability 2/3. What is the expectation?

overview_sentence: A [measurable function](articles/measurable-function.qmd) is a function for which questions about its values correspond to events.
